semantics.registry_rule: Events have exact canonical identities and payload/schema semantics.

semantics.payload_rule: Payload remains inert data until an explicit Trigger/operation consumes it.

semantics.producer_rule: Any producer emitting an Event must reference the canonical Event identity.
semantics.authority_rule: Event emission/receipt does not itself grant execution authority.

invariants.rule: Automation semantics remain explicit across Event, Trigger, Runner and Routine identities, and execution order never derives from incidental structure or serialization order.
